overview: The Medford Community Development Board reviewed plans for a major Herb Chambers Toyota redevelopment at 400 Mystic Avenue, endorsed a lot line adjustment on Jeremiah Circle, and recommended approval of several zoning ordinance updates to the City Council.

items.title: 400 Mystic Avenue Special Permit and Site Plan Review
items.summary: Continued the public hearing to June 26, 2024, regarding Herb Chambers' proposal to construct a new three-story structure, renovate the existing five-story building, and install a car elevator for a motor vehicle dealership.

items.title: 7 and 9 Jeremiah Circle Approval Not Required (ANR)
items.summary: Endorsed an Approval Not Required plan adjusting a rear lot line between 7 and 9 Jeremiah Circle to accommodate pool area clearance.

items.title: Zoning Ordinance Amendments (City Council Paper 24-033)
items.summary: Voted to recommend approval to the City Council for proposed zoning amendments concerning parking table formatting, updated definitions, adoption of a new GIS digital zoning map, and municipal site plan review standards, with a minor edit to footnote placement.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from April 17, 2024.
